title: Clarify Git Workspace Boundaries
intent: Separate manifest persistence, Change management, worktree management, and atomic ref operations
motivation: Git responsibilities are currently spread across GitManifestStore, Worktrees, ChangeIntegration, and application services. Removing early manifest projections creates an opportunity to simplify these boundaries without changing externally visible behavior. Non-goals: no lifecycle redesign, no new state backend, no generic Git abstraction for every Git command, no large public API change.
ordering: Discovery first, then persistence, then Change operations, then worktrees, then hook removal, then the refresh/integration rewrite, then the narrow ports. The core Git refactors run sequentially because they touch the same transaction boundaries.
